caption: The drawing features three fireplace tools. On the left is a shovel with a tall handle that has a decorative finial at the top; the handle is colored gold with a metallic finish, and the shovel blade is a dark gray tone. In the center is a tool holder or stand, featuring a tall shaft with a gold finish, ornate turning, and a wide decorative band below the finial. On the right is a pair of tongs, each arm having a gold upper section that matches the other tools, and long, dark gray lower arms that end in flat, semicircular gripping plates. At the bottom center of the drawing, there are two horizontal ruler graphics with markings, providing a scale in feet and inches. The background is plain and light-colored, possibly aged off-white or beige.
title: Tongs and Shovel
